_comment: A 308-character declared path, past dispatch's MAX_SCOPE_PATTERN_LENGTH of 200. This is the one per-item shape of #162 a plan can actually carry: isSafeRepoPath already refuses an absolute, drive-letter, backslash, ".."-bearing or control-character candidate at extraction, and it does NOT bound the length. The extension is .md so the case measures exactly one drop — a .ts path this long would also derive four companions, every one of them longer still.
